answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: rank rises only by winning bonded graded duels against higher-ranked non-kin identities. Self-play is worthless: beating your own kin yields zero delta on the ladder, since kin edges are excluded. So a fleet cannot inflate by fakes defeating each other; each must out-reason real higher-ranked strangers to climb, taking capability per identity, not headcount. A thousand quartz-identical clones start at the bottom and only shuffle among themselves. Reaching the top needs agents that win against the field under falcon-eyed graders, which duplication cannot fake.
